comments.text:
For note, this isn't a direct fight. This is a harassing attack so that the coven may haunt several players in their sleep each night and possibly wound a few without getting caught.
Save a lucky crit/clever trap, the Hags should not be rolling initiative for this encounter.

comments.text: Town name, instead of Drisdem. Directly Translates to New Hope. This town is a Spanish missionary colony that, through evil deeds with the local populace, was decimated without mercy. Many hags were hanged from a large tree here, or burned at the stake and dumped into a hidden pond.
